purpose: Versioned record of material changes to 3webs, its observation methodology, public interfaces and machine-readable declarations.

releases.summary: Published the commercial capability layer and the companion essay on the Agent-to-Agents paradigm.

changes.change: Published /services.json — capabilities declared direction-neutral, with access lanes carrying their own permitted requesters, data scope, human authorisation threshold and commercial terms.
Published /industries.json — twenty verticals in which Agent-to-Agent adoption is emerging as a monetizable machine-web channel.
Published /a2a-secrets.html — companion essay to The Three Webs, on why internal and external A2A are one paradigm and why price attaches to an access lane rather than to a capability.
Added the three new resources to sitemap.xml and llms.txt.

releases.summary: Repositioned the service as 3webs around observation of the human web, AI web and machine web.

changes.change: Rebranded the service from Audit·AI™ to 3webs.
Introduced the three-web observation model: human web, AI web and machine web.
Published the 167-signal observation catalogue across AI Signals, AEO, GEO, AIO and SEO.
Published machine-readable identity, entity, intent, capability, governance, authority, policy, alias, session and action declarations.
Published an A2A agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json.
Declared 3webs as an observation node of the AiVenture ADI Network.
Published an allow-lane matrix describing permitted automated visitor behavior.
Published a SHA-256 integrity manifest for designated public artifacts.
Published machine-readable governance, AI-use and service-policy declarations.

releases.summary: Moved the observation methodology toward deterministic, evidence-based evaluation.

changes.change: Replaced heuristic scoring with deterministic rules where signals can be objectively tested.
Introduced explicit handling for signals that cannot be reliably verified from available public evidence.
Separated deterministic signal evaluation from language-model narrative synthesis.
Moved language-model synthesis server-side so provider credentials are not exposed to the browser.

a2a_endpoint.note: Declared does not by itself mean verified as operational.

planned.item: Notifications when monitored signal states materially change
Additional external evidence sources for signals that cannot currently be verified reliably
Expanded verification of declared Machine Web and A2A capabilities

change_policy.breaking_changes: Material breaking changes to public machine interfaces should be recorded in this changelog.
change_policy.signal_catalogue_changes: Additions, removals or material definition changes to observation signals should be recorded here.
change_policy.capability_changes: Changes to declared callable capabilities should be reflected in capabilities.json, actions.json and the agent card where applicable.
change_policy.governance_changes: Material changes to governance, AI usage or access policy should be reflected in the corresponding machine-readable declarations.
change_policy.historical_records: Published historical release entries should not be silently rewritten except to correct factual or encoding errors; material corrections should themselves be recorded.

evidence_model.principle: A changelog records declarations about change; operational capability should be verified independently.

integrity.statement: The integrity manifest can demonstrate byte-level consistency of the published changelog with its recorded digest. It does not independently prove that every historical statement in the changelog is true.
